name: currentModuleInfo
invariant: The emit notification receives undefined for skipped plain scripts; transformation assigns collectExternalModuleInfo before invoking any transform delegate and resets only after the delegate returns.

name: arrayFrom
invariant: bindingsSet is a Set<Identifier>; every added binding comes from ExternalModuleInfo.exportedBindings, whose elements are Identifier. The explicit type argument selects the truthful iterable overload and erases on Node.
